SELECT * FROM t_change_log
AND t_change_log.type = #{queryForm.type}
AND ( t_change_log.update_version LIKE '%' || replace(replace(replace(#{queryForm.keyword}, '\', '\\'), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_') || '%' OR t_change_log.publish_author LIKE '%' || replace(replace(replace(#{queryForm.keyword}, '\', '\\'), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_') || '%' OR t_change_log.content LIKE '%' || replace(replace(replace(#{queryForm.keyword}, '\', '\\'), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_') || '%' )
AND t_change_log.public_date >= CAST(#{queryForm.publicDateBegin} AS date)
AND t_change_log.public_date < CAST(#{queryForm.publicDateEnd} AS date) + INTERVAL '1 day'
AND t_change_log.create_time >= CAST(#{queryForm.createTime} AS date) AND t_change_log.create_time < CAST(#{queryForm.createTime} AS date) + INTERVAL '1 day'
AND t_change_log.link = #{queryForm.link}
order by t_change_log.update_version desc
